title: Mold Remediation Asbestos Sampling Tariff: Sampling Line Amount
content:
**Tariff clause.** The amount of the pre-removal asbestos sampling line on a Mold Remediation job is the standard-set charge, which is the tier's asbestos sampling fee covering the collection visit and the laboratory analysis of the standard drywall, joint compound and texture set, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Composition of the line.** The line amount is the total of the standard-set charge and every other charge that belongs to the sampling line, less every credit taken against the sampling line; the total is rounded once, at the end, to the cent, half up.

**Warranty work.** A company warranty job is performed at no charge and carries no sampling line; its sampling figure is 0.00 and nothing is booked.

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The tier | The Mold Remediation job's tier on the job record |
| Asbestos sampling fee | The tier's figure in the Mold Remediation regulated-material fee sheet |
| Funding source | The job record; company warranty means no line |

**Worked figures on hypothetical inputs.**

1. A tier whose asbestos sampling fee is 512.00: the standard-set charge is 512.00 and, with nothing else belonging to the line, the line amount is 512.00.
2. A company warranty job on any tier: 0.00, and no line is booked.
